nodes.label: document-model.md
Контракт: модель документа (v1)
1. Три вида документов Yjs
2. Документ `account`
3. Документ `notebook` (индекс блокнота)
4. Документ `note`
4.1. Совместимость с TipTap / y-prosemirror
4.2. Схема блоков
4.3. `meta` заметки
4.4. `comments`
5. Производные данные (не синхронизируются)
6. Версия формата
Three Yjs document kinds (DocKind): account, notebook, note — different encryption keys
UUIDv7 ids generated on client; docId = notebookId / noteId
Dates ISO 8601 UTC; date-only YYYY-MM-DD; milliseconds only in strokes
Document account: meta, spaces, notebooks, settings, starred, tabs (master key)
Space { id, name, icon, color, order, createdAt }
NotebookRef { id, spaceId, name, icon, color, order, mode: private|agent } — key not stored here
Account settings keys: dailyNotebookId, activeTab, recoveryKeyConfirmed (reset on rotation)
Account starred (note|folder|notebook) and open tabs; settings.activeTab
Document notebook — notebook index: meta, folders, notes (NoteMeta), tags
Notebook doc meta.name / icon / color / space — copy of account names for agents
nodes.rationale: Server cannot read the account doc; agents in «for agents» mode need notebook/space names; color added 2026-10-26 so the agent consent screen draws the notebook icon in its colour.

nodes.label: Folder { id, parentId, name, icon, color, order } — unlimited nesting
NoteMeta (notebook index entry: folderId, parentNoteId, title, kind, dailyDate, tags, icon, coverThumb, wrappedKey, trashedAt, order)
NoteMeta.createdByAgent { agentId, agentName, at } | null (D-45) — «Создано агентом» strip, «Понятно» sets null
Notebook tags map: tagName → { color, icon } (optional tag properties)
Daily notes and Inbox (kind daily / inbox) in settings.dailyNotebookId notebook
Document note: content (Y.XmlFragment), meta, strokes, comments
TipTap / y-prosemirror compatibility of content (§4.1); iOS Yrs must read/write same format
Mark value is an attribute object ({ bold: {} }); readers accept {} / true / name--hash keys
Text insertion inherits formatting from the left — writers always pass explicit attributes
y-prosemirror does not write null node attributes; absent attribute = null (schema default)
Document model compatibility vectors packages/test-vectors/document/*
Block schema: doc = title block+ (paragraph, heading, lists, taskList, blockquote, callout, codeBlock, mathBlock, mermaid, table, image, file, drawing, pageCard)
blockId (UUIDv7) on every block node — for agent edits, margin notes, comments; new id on split/insert
taskItem: taskId, state open|done|cancelled, scheduled, deadline, completedAt
callout block: tone note|info|success|warning|danger + emoji
codeBlock: text without marks except agentEdit (2026-10-26)
tableHeader/tableCell align left|center|right|null (from Markdown column alignment)
drawing block: displayed height = height × blockWidth / 600 (strokes in strokes map)
pageCard — nested note card (noteId, style card|link)
Never delete «непонятное» — nodes failing client schema validation are kept as-is on open (rule for all clients, 2026-10-26)
nodes.rationale: Web editor deleted agent-created code blocks (agentEdit mark inside codeBlock) on open and the deletion synced — data loss.

nodes.label: Unknown nodes and marks preserved as-is, shown as «Неподдерживаемый блок»
nodes.rationale: Old client versions must not corrupt documents written by newer versions.

nodes.label: noteLink inline atom (noteId, label — [[ ]] text)
Inline atoms: tag (name without #, nested via /), mention (reserved)
hardBreak — inline line break inside a paragraph
Marks bold, italic, underline, strike, code; highlight / textColor (color token)
link mark = { href } (target/rel added at render; readers tolerate extra fields)
agentEdit mark { agentId, at } — agent edit highlight until accepted (D-10)
Note meta: style (font, width, paper, textColor), cover {attachmentId, offsetY}, backdrop
Comment { blockId, anchor (relative positions), author user|guest|agent, text, resolvedAt }
Derived local data (task index, full-text search, backlinks, tags) — not synced
nodes.rationale: Server cannot see content (E2E encryption), so each client builds indexes locally.

nodes.label: meta.formatVersion = 1; newer document opens read-only (R-03)

hyperedges.label: Never delete invalid/unknown content across clients (contract rule, iOS and web implementations)
